title: oscore: ContextId ignores recipient_id (registry false-conflicts documented as impossible); doc caveat or mix recipient_id
description: derive_context_id (rust/lichen-oscore, SHA-256 over secret/salt/id_context/own-sender_id) means two sessions sharing (secret, salt, id_context, sender_id) but different peers collide on one registry record — one peer's receiver blocks the other's. Not reachable under LICHEN's per-peer EDHOC-derived secrets, but the module doc claims the id pins exactly one recipient unconditionally. Fix: doc caveat, or mix recipient_id into the record key. Restart stability is fine (id is a pure function of key material). Discovered reviewing f4b089027c.
